checks.note: issueStrikeSafely catches only PessimisticLockingFailureException; any other runtime exception from reliabilityStrikeService.issue (REQUIRES_NEW confines data rollback but not propagation) resumes in onBookingCancelledByCoach and rolls back its REQUIRES_NEW transaction, destroying the saveCancellationHistory row saved earlier in the same method, with no retry since AFTER_COMMIT listener exceptions are only logged. PessimisticLockRetryer isn't shown, but the finding fails only if issue wrapped all failures as lock exceptions, which the method's own Javadoc (catch is specifically for lock-retry exhaustion) contradicts.

The crash window itself is real in this file: onBookingCancelledByCoach/onCoachNoShow are AFTER_COMMIT + REQUIRES_NEW, writing history and strikes only after the booking commit, with no outbox here. But the finding's verification caveat — that no sweeper/reconciliation rebuilds coach_cancellation_history and BookingCancelledByCoachEvent has no outbox redelivery — requires schedulers, other CoachCancellationHistoryRepository callers, and the event publisher, none of which were provided; permanence cannot be confirmed from this file alone.
